page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: non potuerunt, compendio ea, quæ controver-sa ipsis sunt, exponunto; sententiam generalium Ordinum de iisdem expectanto. Agrariis liberum esto cerevisiam in usum familiæ suæ coquere; venundandi quæstusque faciendi causâ, non esto; nec in tabernis aut diversoriis ullius cerevisiæ præterquàm Groningane usus per totum agrum concessus habetor. Groningani in possessione loci prioris in scribendo, signando, sedendo, suffragiis ferendis manento, pariaque suffragia in actionibus & deliberationibus provincialibus retinento. Suffragiis inter se pugnantibus omnes modi & rationes æquæ & usitatæ adhibentor ad ea concilianda: si id non successerit per Gubernatorem, & delectos ab utraque parte parinumero dissensio dirimitor, usque dum modus alius melior fuerit ad hanc rem repertus & introductus: conventus Ordinum indicuntor suffragiis Ordinum eorundem congregatorum, aut edicto Gubernatoris, aut denunciatione eorum, qui eâ de re mandata habebunt, idque iis locis, qui idonei maximè videbuntur. Acta, novationes, usurpationes, quæ adversantur his, ac impedimento sunt, abrogata & pro nullis sunto, nec quicquam

page.notes: Catchword "impsleo-" is partly doubtful: the first letters are clear but the last letters are blurred, so it is marked [?]. The word "Groningane" is read from a partly obscured line (the text is faint near the centre-left) and is not fully certain. Stains and show-through on the left edge and bottom right, plus a faint digitiser mark at the bottom right, were left out.
